lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: This fog isn't natural — it's holding at the same height it was an hour ago.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: Then we walk quiet and we walk close. Fog like that hides more than it shows.

lines.speaker: Maeve Ashwood
lines.text: Rain again. Half the camp will have coughs by week's end.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: Then we dry them out and we keep them warm. The sky is not our enemy today.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: Weak gate, no watch on the north road. This place is one bad night from ruin.

lines.speaker: Maeve Ashwood
lines.text: Then let's give them a good day first. Fear can wait behind a full stomach.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: Look at the roof-lines — half rebuilt, half burned. They're deciding whether to stay.

lines.speaker: Torren
lines.text: They'll stay. People don't rebuild a roof they mean to leave under.

lines.speaker: Ragash
lines.text: The hounds won't drink here. Something upstream.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: Then neither do we. Fill from the spring we passed.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: The birdsong stopped four hundred paces back. Nobody noticed but the trees.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: The Old Ways say a silent wood is a wood holding its breath. Keep your hope where you can reach it.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: Pack sign. Old. They ranged wide here once.

lines.speaker: Ragash
lines.text: And could again, if someone gave them a reason to trust a two-legs.

lines.speaker: Torren
lines.text: Dwarf-cut, this. Feel how the air moves? They built it to breathe.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: Then let's not be the ones who teach it to hold its breath.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: Someone loved this place. You can tell by what they saved before they ran.

lines.speaker: Torren
lines.text: Aye. And someone hated it, by what they left broken. Both are still here in the stone.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: Men died holding this wall. You can read it in the arrow-scars.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: Then we'll say their names to the wind. A wall remembers, even when the world forgets.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: Clean work. Nobody we came in with is lying in the grass.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: That's the only kind of victory worth the word.

lines.speaker: Ragash
lines.text: We won.

lines.speaker: Maeve Ashwood
lines.text: We survived. Winning is what we do with the time it buys us.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: We gave ground. I hate giving ground.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: Ground can be taken back. Breath cannot. You made the right call, captain.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: I filled six pages today and understood maybe one of them.

lines.speaker: Maeve Ashwood
lines.text: That's one more than yesterday. Now eat, and let the other five wait for morning.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: Strange, isn't it. A fire, a full watch, and none of us quite trusting the quiet.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: The quiet's earned. Let it be quiet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: To the ones who aren't at this fire, and to the ones who still might be. Rest.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: This is it. Whatever's been wearing the Frontier like a mask — it's here.

lines.speaker: Talos
lines.text: Then we take the mask off. Together, on my mark, and not before.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: Whatever it shows us, remember it is afraid of exactly one thing: people who refuse to run.

lines.speaker: Corwin
lines.text: There. See it now? I told you the land was trying to say something.

lines.speaker: Ronan
lines.text: You did. I'll stop doubting your notebook. Mostly.
